progression.narrative: The performance opens on Eb4 and dwells most on Eb in Maghlub. The line peaks at Ab4 (437.2 Hz) at 0:16.1. It closes on Eb4, not the tonic (Ds4 → Eb4 → Eb4 → Ds4 → Ds4 → Eb4).
